_README: Single source of truth for every clinic fact on the site. Leave a value empty ("") until it is VERIFIED — the build shows a clearly marked placeholder and prints a warning instead of inventing anything. Run `npm run build` after editing.
name: Treon Dental
description: Family, cosmetic and orthodontic dentistry in Phoenix, AZ, led by Dr. Robert Treon, DDS. Se habla español.

form._note: provider: 'netlify' (Netlify Forms, works when deployed on Netlify) or 'endpoint' (any service that accepts a JSON POST, e.g. Formspree or your own HIPAA-compliant backend). See README → Appointment form.

photos._note: Paths are relative to src/ (e.g. "assets/img/hero.avif"). Leave empty to show the art-directed placeholder.

dentist.name: Dr. Robert Treon
dentist.bio: Dr. Treon has practiced dentistry since 2007 and opened Treon Dental in Phoenix in October 2009. He cares for patients of all ages, from routine family visits to orthodontic and cosmetic treatment.
dentist.education: Bachelor's degree, Creighton University · DDS, Creighton University School of Dentistry (President of his dental class)
dentist.memberships: American Dental Association · Arizona Dental Association · Central Arizona Dental Society
dentist.interests: Family dentistry, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry and conscious sedation

payment.insurance: We accept most traditional dental insurance plans. Call us and we'll help you check your coverage.
payment.financing: Financing may be available through CareCredit.

faq.insurance: We accept most traditional dental insurance plans. Call our office and we'll gladly help you check your coverage before your visit.
faq.financing: Financing may be available through CareCredit. Ask our team for details.

technology.name: Digital X-rays
technology.text: Detailed images that help your dentist see what the eye can't, with results available in moments.

technology.name: Intraoral cameras
technology.text: A tiny camera lets you see exactly what your dentist sees, so every recommendation is easy to understand.

technology.name: 3D imaging
technology.text: Three-dimensional views support careful planning for implants and complex treatment.

technology.name: Digital impressions
technology.text: A quick optical scan can replace traditional impression material for many restorations.
